title: Motion Graphics and Code-Generated BGM
originalPost:
구글 제미나이 4 아르곤(Gemini 4 Argon) 출시되자마자 모션 그래픽 생성으로 성능 테스트를 해봄. (결과물은 위 20초 영상 참고)

bgm, 모션 그래픽 전부 제미나이4 argon 으로 만듬.

기존 플래그십 모델들(솔 6.1, 아스트라 6, 페이블 5.1, 오퍼스 5.5, 제미나이 3.8)과 비교해 보며 굴려본 솔직한 체감 후기

1. 체감 티어 비교
- 이전 세대인 제미나이 3.8보다는 확실히 체감될 정도로 좋아짐.
- 솔(Sol) 6.1보다도 한 단계 우위에 있는 느낌.
- 아스트라(Astra) 6, 페이블(Fable) 5.1과는 이제 거의 비등비등한 수준까지 바짝 따라붙었음.
- 다만 여전히 넘사벽인 오퍼스(Opus) 5.5급의 정교함까지는 아직 도달하지 못한 느낌.

2. 'AI 슬롭' 극복이 관건
그냥 일반적인 프롬프트로 대충 뽑아달라고 하면 특유의 뻔한 AI 슬롭(양산형 느낌)이 강하게 남. 
연출 의도, 모션의 가감속(Easing), 비주얼 디테일을 빡빡하게 지정해 줘야 비로소 영상처럼 제대로 된 완성도가 나옴. 프롬프트 디테일 의존도가 꽤 있는 편.

3. 속도와 개발 활용도
일단 생성 및 응답 속도가 상당히 빠름.
개발 성능도 테스트해 보니 기대 이상으로 준수해서, 최고난도의 복잡한 아키텍처 설계가 아니라면 일상적인 코딩 작업이나 프로토타이핑 개발 용도로는 가성비 좋게 굴리기 충분해 보임.

더 여러 환경에서 굴려봐야겠지만, 속도 빠르고 개발·제작 보조용으로 밸런스를 꽤 잘 뽑아낸 모델임.

일단 지금 gpt 너무 느려터지고 성능도 떨어진 거 같아서 취소하고 제미나이를 업그레이해서 쓸까 생각중.

title: 3D Animation Principles Loop
originalPost:
在 AI Studio 中使用 Default Mode 基于 Gemini 4 Argon 构建的 Claude opus 5.5 同款小动画。
原始提示词在评论区。
链接：https://ai.studio/apps/222fea70-e8f5-4ab6-8fbc-4977978a415d
prompt:
Build a 3D animation-principles loop. One HTML file, three.js 0.160.0 via jsDelivr importmap, Geist Mono from Google Fonts. 1080x1080, 8 s at 60 fps (480 frames), frame 480 equals frame 0. window.renderAt(t) draws any frame from t alone; seeded random only.

Set: a miniature studio. A floating white 12x6 slab on an F4F2EE backdrop. Its top is a timeline: 3 tracks of 0.25 frame cells (EFEEEA), a ruler with frame numbers, 5 keyframe diamonds 2 units apart on the middle track (white fill, 0F0F0F outline). Around it on stands: a key softbox, a rim strip light, a top spot on a boom.
Hero: the pixel Claude mascot as 0.1 voxels: D97757 body 14x10x8, two 3x2 arms, four 2x3 legs, 0F0F0F 2x3 eyes; roughness 0.45, clearcoat 0.3.

Lights, 0 to 1 s: key 3200 K with soft shadows at 0.1 s, rim 7500 K at 0.4 s, top spot 5000 K at 0.7 s. Each clicks on with a 3-frame flicker, and the mascot's eyes glance at it.
Hops, 1 to 5 s: 4 hops to diamonds 2 to 5, landing on frames 105, 165, 225 and 285. Each hop: 11-frame crouch (1.2x0.75), stretch 0.85x1.28 at takeoff, 25 frames of air, squash 1.25x0.7 on landing, spring back at damping 0.55; arms lag 4 frames, legs 6. Each landing lights its diamond FF6A2B, ripples the cells 0.08 high and throws 12 voxel sparks. An FF6A2B playhead carrying a point light moves at constant speed and crosses each diamond on its landing frame.
Flip, 5 to 6.4 s: a dotted arc from diamond 5 back to diamond 1 draws in, then an 18-frame deep crouch and a 360° flip along the arc, 3.5 high, landing on frame 384 while the playhead rewinds under it.
Labels, top left, Geist Mono 28 px: a checklist 01 ANTICIPATION, 02 SQUASH & STRETCH (& in D97757), 03 OVERLAPPING ACTION, 04 FOLLOW-THROUGH, 05 ARCS, in 8E8A83. Each row turns 0F0F0F and fills its FF6A2B diamond on its exact frame: 69 (first crouch), 140 (stretch), 200 (limbs trail), 285 (arms settle), 303 (arc draws).
End: hold, blink at 7.2 s; on frame 468 the lights, diamonds and labels snap off.
Camera: FOV 18, 30° elevation, ±10° orbit over 8 s, 25% push-in tracking the hops, 4% punch-in on the flip landing.
Post: bloom on emissives, depth of field focused on the mascot, 2% grain, 10% vignette, dithered backdrop.

1. The render is washed out and cramped. Grade so the lit front face reads D97757 and lit diamonds read FF6A2B; drop the fill so lights-off sits near 50% and each click is obvious; lower the key to 28 degrees from the front right and put the cool rim at the back left so it edges the side we see. Pull the wide shot back to 44 units so the whole floating slab and all three stands are in frame, add a soft shadow under the slab, and make sparks 0.075 to 0.12 and ruler numbers bigger.
2. Frame check fixes. Keep every prop out of the label block: track the hops at 45% and hang the top spot at 5.8 on a boom from the back right corner, above the flip. Light each lit diamond with a soft glow from its face, move the playhead light to the front edge of the track and run its line under the diamonds. Start the dotted arc above the mascot's head, keep every tripod foot on the slab, and give the arms a bigger, slower settle (2.2 Hz, damping 0.22) so the follow-through reads.
3. Turn the rim strip's panel toward the camera so its click reads.
4. Make the top spot's click read too: narrow it to a 34 degree pool at 45 cd and give the lamp a glowing lens rim.

# Sound prompt
Score this 8 s loop, 480 frames at 60 fps. Synthesize everything in code with the Web Audio API, no samples, no downloads. 120 BPM, 4 bars, F major. Each hit lands 1 frame after its visual event.
Bed: pad voices A3 E4 (key light), C5 (top), G5 (rim), each following its light's flicker. Shaker 8ths from 45, kick and bass from 60, roots F D Bb F by bar; kick and shaker rest 330 to 420, bass holds C, then F at 384.
Clicks: lights 6, 24, 42, off 468.
Crouches 69, 129, 189, 249, 312: creak, inhale riser.
Takeoffs 80, 140, 200, 260, 330: upward swish.
Landings 105, 165, 225, 285, 384: rubber squash pitched by the squash scale, spark tings, 384 biggest.
Label pings A5 C6 D6 F6 A6: 69, 140, 200, 285, 303.
Dot ticks 303 to 318, flip whoosh 330 to 384, blink blip 432.
48 kHz stereo WAV, about -14 LUFS, peak -1 dBTP, seamless loop, mux into the MP4.

prompt:
Create a beautiful, highly detailed, fully interactive 3D prehistoric island using Three.js and WebGL. Deliver everything in a single standalone HTML file that opens directly in Chrome. Embed assets wherever possible.
VISUAL DIRECTION
Build a large, rounded island surrounded by an ocean with a transparent underwater cross-section. The result should feel like a premium miniature world: lush vegetation, expressive dinosaurs, rich materials, atmospheric lighting, and polished animation. Use a cohesive, stylized art direction rather than basic geometric shapes.
ISLAND
Create varied terrain with beaches, rocky cliffs, dense prehistoric forests, giant ferns, a waterfall, a freshwater pond, and a volcano. Add a small research station, wooden walkways, observation platforms, supply crates, and dinosaur nests. Make the island spacious enough for dinosaurs to move naturally between distinct areas.
WATER CROSS-SECTION
The water must form a deep, rounded volume around the island, with clearly visible underwater scenery through its sides. Include a textured seabed, rocks, aquatic plants, fish, bubbles, and a green marine reptile swimming beneath the surface. Do not place ordinary land dinosaurs underwater, and do not add a submarine.
Use animated waves, Fresnel reflections, underwater light patterns, shoreline foam, and splashes. Avoid transparency sorting artifacts and visible gaps between the island and water.
DINOSAURS
Include several distinct species, such as a long-necked sauropod, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, a large theropod, and smaller herd animals. Add pterosaurs circling overhead.
Give every species recognizable anatomy, shaped bodies, articulated limbs, detailed heads, tails, and appropriate skin patterns. Avoid assembling the finished dinosaurs from obvious boxes or disconnected spheres.
NATURAL ANIMATION
Use hierarchical skeletons with correctly positioned joints. Walking must have distinct stance and swing phases: feet stay planted during contact and lift cleanly during each step. Match stride length to movement speed.
Use terrain sampling and inverse kinematics to keep feet on the ground. Add weight shifts, subtle body movement, balanced tail motion, head turns, and breathing. Dinosaurs must never float, slide, intersect the ground, or walk through buildings, rocks, trees, or each other.
Use obstacle avoidance and safe paths. Different species should have different movement speeds, gait patterns, and behaviors. Marine animals must face their direction of travel.
INTERACTION
Allow users to:
Rotate the camera freely, zoom, and inspect the underwater cross-section.
Select a dinosaur and follow it with a smoothly moving camera.
Place food in suitable locations and watch nearby dinosaurs approach and eat.
Trigger drinking, resting, calling, and herd movement.
Explore nests and watch a hatchling emerge.
Trigger a marine reptile surfacing with a splash.
Switch between daylight, sunset, and night.
Adjust rain, wind, and volcanic activity.
Pause the simulation and reset the scene.
Make every control produce a clear, visible response. Keep interactions repeatable and prevent overlapping animations from breaking character poses.
ATMOSPHERE AND AUDIO
Add moving foliage, drifting clouds, birds, insects, rain particles, and warm research-station lights at night. Include quiet atmospheric music and environmental sounds with a working music toggle and volume slider. Start audio only after user interaction.
INTERFACE
Use a compact, elegant interface with English labels. Keep the scene dominant and avoid large panels covering the island. Make the layout responsive for desktop and mobile.
TECHNICAL QUALITY
Use instancing for repeated vegetation and props, efficient geometry, appropriate shadows, and restrained post-processing. Balance visual richness with smooth real-time performance.
Build a complete scene, not a mockup. Test the final HTML directly in a desktop browser, inspect screenshots and the console, exercise every interaction, and fix loading errors, floating dinosaurs, foot sliding, broken collisions, water artifacts, and camera problems before delivery.

prompt:
我要做一个全屏网页交互场景："树脂块微缩岛屿"。参考我上传的参考图，做出一张树脂方块里装着悬崖、沙滩和清澈青绿海水的实拍风格图，要达到那种真实质感；整块像果冻一样跟着鼠标晃，水面随鼠标起浪，水要果冻质感

技术栈：Vite + React + TypeScript，three + @react-three/fiber v9 + @react-three/drei + @react-three/postprocessing，leva 做调参面板。所有 3D 内容全部用代码程序化生成，不加载任何模型文件；环境光用 drei 的 Environment 预设即可。遵循 R3F 和 drei 的官方最佳实践。

场景要有：
- 一个圆角透明树脂块，块体本身就是海水，用 MeshTransmissionMaterial 做出通透感和由浅到深的青绿色水色。
- 块体内部的沙色海床，带焦散光斑，散布几块岩石，部分露出水面。
- 块体顶面的动态水面：GPU 高度场模拟，鼠标划过起涟漪，空闲时也有微弱自然波动；要有反射、浅深水混色和岸边泡沫。
- 一角的程序化岛屿：噪声地形塑出陡峭悬崖和一弯沙滩，按高度和坡度分层着色，缓坡上实例化散布简单几何体做植被。
- 果冻效果：整个场景跟随鼠标位移做弹簧式晃动，块体顶部晃得比底部多。
- 产品摄影式的呈现：米白背景、长焦俯视相机、接触阴影、景深做出微缩感，轻微泛光和暗角。
- leva 面板：水色、浪高、涟漪强度、太阳角度、潮位、果冻软硬、景深。

要求：桌面 60fps，手机 30fps 以上并自动降级；组件按职责拆分，高度场模拟独立成 hook；先跑通整体，再精修材质和参数。

I had Argon 4 one shot an OS. It took under 2 min and turned out surprisingly well. No weirdness in what it turned out over here.

prompt:
Build a single self-contained HTML file that is a fully functional fake operating system running in the browser. One file, no external dependencies, no CDN links, everything inline. It should open and immediately boot like a real computer.

Requirements-
1: a boot sequence with ASCII art logo, kernel messages scrolling line by line with realistic delays, ending in a login prompt. 
2: a login screen where the user types a username and password. Accept any input but respond with a witty error if the password is wrong, like "incorrect password, nice try." 
3: after login, launch a terminal-style shell with a command prompt. Support at least these commands: help, ls, cd, cat, mkdir, touch, rm, echo, date, whoami, uname, ping, history, clear, exit, and a secret command you invent that's hidden unless someone reads the source. 
4: implement a fake file system with directories like home, etc, var, tmp, and a few files with realistic content, like a README, a config file, and maybe a diary entry from the fictional OS creator. 
5: make cd actually change the working directory and update the prompt to show the current path. 
6: add a taskbar or status bar at the bottom showing time, username, and memory usage that ticks in real time. 
7: include a settings panel accessible from a menu where the user can change the wallpaper, font color, and terminal font. 
8: add a fun easter egg, like a snake game or a matrix rain effect triggered by a specific key combo. 
9: the whole thing should feel production quality, with smooth animations, a boot chime using the Web Audio API, and no console errors. 
10: at the end of the file, include a comment block listing every feature and command so people can see what you built.

Make it look and feel like a real retro-futuristic OS, think 1990s sci-fi meets modern polish. Do not ask me any questions. Just output the complete HTML file in one response.

title: Pirate ship
originalPost:
Gemini ４ Argon × Three.jsで海賊船
―――
おもしろ！
Gemini、CG系も頑張れるようになってる！

つかったプロンプトはリプに↓
prompt:
架空の海賊船（17世紀のガレオン船風・3本マスト・船名なし）が、

羊皮紙の図面から組み上がって夕暮れの海へ出航するアニメーションを、

Three.js のWebページとして作ってください。最後に MP4 にも書き出してください。

【形】船の寸法・部品・組み上がる順番とタイミングは、設計書（データ1つ）にまとめる。

  船体（なめらかな曲面）、肋材、甲板、船尾楼と船首楼、大砲22門と赤い砲門、

  3本のマストと帆桁、索具（縄ばしご付き）、横帆6枚＋三角帆＋斜檣帆、

  金の飾り、船尾の窓と角灯、船首像、ドクロ旗と吹き流し。

【流れ】約20秒＋ロゴ3.5秒、音つき。

  1. 羊皮紙の巻物が上から広がり、セピアの甲板平面図が現れる（方位盤・題字・封蝋つき、真上から）

  2. 図面の線が光る線として立ち上がる

  3. 竜骨 → 肋材 → 外板（下から1段ずつ張られる）→ 甲板 → 大砲 → マスト → 帆桁 → 索具 → 帆

     → 金の飾り・角灯・旗の順に組み上がる（カメラは船に寄る）

  4. 紙が消え、下から海が満ちて船が浮かぶ。夕焼けの空が現れ、カメラは引く

  5. 角灯がともり、帆が風をはらんで進み出す（波に揺れ、旗がはためく）

  6. 右舷の大砲が三発 → タイトル「海賊船」→ 最後に指定のロゴ

  音は外部素材を使わず Python で合成する（船乗りの歌・木槌・波・かもめ・大砲）。

【ページの機能】

  - 再生／一時停止、スライダーで好きな場面へ移動、今の場面名を表示、音と映像を同期

  - 自動カメラと自由カメラ（マウスで船の周りを回せる）の切り替え

  - 空は Three.js の Sky に夕焼けの色を重ね、海は Water で船を映す。光るものにはブルーム

【MP4 書き出し】

  ページに書き出しモードを付け、1920×1080 で1コマずつ画像を保存する

  （タイトルの文字も画像に描き込む）。ffmpeg で音とロゴをつないで MP4 にする。

【進め方】

  - 場面ごとに画面を見て崩れやエラーがないか確認する

  - 白飛び・暗すぎ・文字と船の重なりがあれば直してから書き出す

title: Exploded mechanical watch
originalPost:
我也快速地用gemini 4 Argon 摸了一个3d交互网页

我选了"可拆解的机械腕表"做题目。
原因是它很考推理：齿轮要真的咬合、传动比要算对，部件多，还有拆解动画，比太阳系、汽车这类常见题目更容易拉开模型之间的差距。

提示词如下 ：

你是顶尖的创意技术专家，精通 Three.js、实时渲染和机械钟表结构。请做一个单文件网页 index.html：一只可交互、可拆解的自动上链机械腕表 3D 模型。

【硬性约束】
- 只输出一个完整的 index.html，双击就能在 Chrome 里运行，不需要构建工具或本地服务器。
- 用 importmap 引入 Three.js
- 不加载任何外部模型、贴图或字体，所有几何体和纹理都用代码程序化生成。
- 输出完整代码，不要省略，不要写"此处略"。

【模型】
- 至少 30 个独立部件，包括：表壳、表耳、表冠、蓝宝石表镜、表盘（刻度和自拟品牌名用 Canvas 绘制）、时针、分针、秒针、发条盒、中心轮、三轮、四轮、擒纵轮、擒纵叉、摆轮与游丝、自动陀、夹板、螺丝、红宝石轴承。
- 齿轮要有真实齿形，啮合位置正确。先算好各齿轮的齿数和传动比，保证秒针 60 秒一圈、分针 60 分钟一圈、时针 12 小时一圈。
- 尺寸比例参照真实的 40mm 表径手表。

【材质与灯光】
- 使用 PBR 材质：拉丝和抛光不锈钢、镀金夹板、烤蓝螺丝、半透明红宝石，以及带透射和折射效果的蓝宝石玻璃（MeshPhysicalMaterial）。
- 用 RoomEnvironment 生成环境反射，开启 ACES 色调映射、柔和阴影和轻微的 bloom。

【动画】
- 指针显示本地的真实当前时间。
- 机芯要真实运转：摆轮往复摆动，擒纵叉和擒纵轮按节拍配合，各齿轮按自己的传动比转动。

【交互】
- 鼠标和触控都能旋转、缩放、平移，带阻尼。
- 鼠标悬停在部件上时描边高亮，并显示部件名。
- 点击部件时，相机平滑聚焦到它，同时弹出信息卡，写明名称、作用、齿数和转速。
- 控制面板包含：
  - 爆炸视图滑块（0–100%，沿轴向分层平滑拆开）
  - 剖切平面滑块
  - 时间倍速（1x–3600x）
  - 表盘显示/隐藏
  - 一键复位视角

【界面与性能】
- 中文界面，深色玻璃拟态风格，带加载动画，适配手机屏幕。
- 桌面端稳定 60fps：重复的部件用 InstancedMesh，devicePixelRatio 上限设为 2。
- 控制台不能有报错。

【工作方式】
1. 先写设计方案：部件清单、场景层级、齿轮齿数和传动比的计算过程。
2. 再写完整代码。
3. 最后对照上面每一条要求逐项自查，没做到的先改好，再输出最终版本。

- 使用 PBR 材质：拉丝和抛光不锈钢、镀金夹板、烤蓝螺丝、半透明红宝石，以及带透射和折射效果的蓝宝石玻璃（MeshPhysicalMaterial）。
- 用 RoomEnvironment 生成环境反射，开启 ACES 色调映射、柔和阴影和轻微的 bloom。

【动画】
- 指针显示本地的真实当前时间。
- 机芯要真实运转：摆轮往复摆动，擒纵叉和擒纵轮按节拍配合，各齿轮按自己的传动比转动。

【交互】
- 鼠标和触控都能旋转、缩放、平移，带阻尼。
- 鼠标悬停在部件上时描边高亮，并显示部件名。
- 点击部件时，相机平滑聚焦到它，同时弹出信息卡，写明名称、作用、齿数和转速。
- 控制面板包含：
  - 爆炸视图滑块（0–100%，沿轴向分层平滑拆开）
  - 剖切平面滑块
  - 时间倍速（1x–3600x）
  - 表盘显示/隐藏
  - 一键复位视角

【界面与性能】
- 中文界面，深色玻璃拟态风格，带加载动画，适配手机屏幕。
- 桌面端稳定 60fps：重复的部件用 InstancedMesh，devicePixelRatio 上限设为 2。
- 控制台不能有报错。

【工作方式】
1. 先写设计方案：部件清单、场景层级、齿轮齿数和传动比的计算过程。
2. 再写完整代码。
3. 最后对照上面每一条要求逐项自查，没做到的先改好，再输出最终版本。

prompt:
Build "Gummy Bears" - a single self-contained HTML file (three.js from a CDN is the only dependency): a handful of translucent gummy bears on a white table that you can grab, stretch, squash, throw and pour.

The bears
- Classic gummy bear silhouette: round head with two ears, short snout, plump body, stubby arms and legs, tiny molded eyes and nose

Physics (this is the whole point - it must feel like jelly, not plastic)
- Each bear is a soft body: mass points for head, ears, snout, body, belly, hands and feet, held together by volume-preserving shape matching

- Pull the head up: the neck stretches, the body follows, on release the bear squashes and hops

- Idle bears do small random hops with squash and stretch

prompt:
Create a **single self-contained HTML file** using **Three.js** that renders a highly realistic, cinematic black hole inspired by **Gargantua from Interstellar**.

Prioritize visual realism over UI complexity. The black hole should have:
A deep black event horizon
Strong gravitational lensing that visibly bends the accretion disk around the black hole
A bright photon ring near the event horizon
A thin, detailed accretion disk with turbulent glowing material
The characteristic lensed disk appearing both above and below/behind the black hole
Relativistic Doppler beaming: one side brighter/bluer and the opposite side dimmer/redder
Bloom, HDR-like highlights, subtle noise, and a realistic star field
Smooth animation of the accretion material without looking like a simple rotating texture

Use shaders wherever necessary rather than relying only on standard Three.js materials.

Add a clean, compact floating control panel with real-time sliders for:
Black hole mass / apparent size
Spin
Gravitational lensing strength
Photon ring intensity
Accretion disk inner radius
Accretion disk outer radius
Disk thickness
Disk brightness
Disk temperature/color
Doppler / relativistic effect strength
Disk rotation speed
Turbulence
Bloom intensity
Exposure
Camera distance
Camera inclination/viewing angle
Star-field brightness

Changes should update immediately while dragging the sliders.

Allow mouse/touch orbiting and zooming, but keep the initial camera angle composed like a cinematic Interstellar-style shot.

Keep the interface minimal and dark so the black hole remains the focus. Include **Reset to Default**, **Pause Animation**, and **Hide Controls** buttons.

Everything must run directly from the one HTML file with no build process. Make the simulation visually convincing first; don't add unrelated features, explanatory sections, menus, or unnecessary UI.

Before finishing, test the rendering, controls, resizing, animation performance, and shader compilation errors. Aim for the closest practical approximation of a physically plausible Interstellar-style black hole achievable in real-time WebGL.
